**Stationary Points of O’Hara’s Knot Energies**

*Simon Blatt∗*

19 pp, 5 sections.

**Abstract.** In this article we study the regularity of stationary points of the knot ener- gies E(α) introduced by O’Hara in [14, 15, 16] in the range α ∈(2, 3). In a ﬁrst step we prove that E(α) is C1 on the set of all regular embedded curves belonging to H(α+1)/2,2(R/Z, Rn) and calculate its derivative. After that we use the structure of the Euler-Lagrange equation to study the regularity of stationary points of E(α) plus a positive multiple of the length. We show that stationary points of ﬁnite energy are of class C∞— so especially all local minimizers of E(α) among curves with ﬁxed length are smooth.

**Outline.** Front matter; 1 Introduction; 2 Continuous differentiability; 3 Regularity of stationary points; A Results on fractional Sobolev spaces
